comment_text: Fair value gap (fvg) is an area where price rises or drops significantly within a short period of time, this doesn’t allow people to buy or sell in that fvg. So naturally price is drawn back into the fvg, and you get what’s called retracement. This is when you’re in an uptrend (uptrend is when price is generally moving upward) and then price moves down a little but then continues back up. Using a fair value gap is a way to predict retracement, that way you can buy in at a lower price and you’re already expecting price to continue increasing so you can make your profits
